name: StrataSight: NASA Earth Science Data & Trend Detective
description: Team StrataSight (Muhammad Arslan Toor, Fatima Noor). A NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 entry that turns real NASA and NOAA satellite data into plain-language answers about how the Earth is changing, with Mann-Kendall and Sen's slope tests, a CesiumJS globe streaming NASA GIBS imagery, and multi-agency live labs.
